testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a mini wheel size preference change: tmp/obk-wheel-size-3943-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:59:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a mini wheel size preference change ✔ Given the full navigation wheel is open over a model in the MCAD Software ✔ And the saved mini wheel size is Normal ✔ When the user opens Options from the wheel context menu ✔ Then the dialog shows tool message and tool tip controls ✔ And it shows mini wheel size, big wheel size and wheel opacity controls ✔ And it shows navigation options and a walk speed factor slider ✔ When the user opens the mini wheel size list ✔ Then it offers Small, Normal, Large and Extra Large ✔ When the user chooses Extra Large ✔ Then the mini wheel size field displays Extra Large ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ And the user reopens Options from the wheel context menu ✔ Then the mini wheel size field displays Normal ✔ When the user clicks Cancel and presses Escape ✔ Then the options dialog and wheel are closed
